description: Layer 1 trigger pack for broad feature audits across competitors, UX, product gaps, risks, and roadmap direction.

shouldTrigger.prompt: Audit our upgrade funnel end to end: competitor patterns, product gaps, UX friction, and a roadmap for what to build next.
shouldTrigger.reason: Broad feature analysis with gaps, competitor context, and roadmap.

shouldTrigger.prompt: Do a quick feature audit of onboarding with auto effort and tell me only the top priorities.
shouldTrigger.reason: Still a feature-audit request even when the user asks for a lighter effort profile.

shouldTrigger.prompt: Analyze this search feature from every relevant angle and tell me what is missing overall.
shouldTrigger.reason: Broad feature analysis with gaps, competitor context, and roadmap.

shouldTrigger.prompt: I want a serious feature audit for our notifications settings experience, not just one narrow critique.
shouldTrigger.reason: Broad feature analysis with gaps, competitor context, and roadmap.

shouldTrigger.prompt: Audit this subscription feature across user value, trust, friction, and roadmap opportunities.
shouldTrigger.reason: Broad feature analysis with gaps, competitor context, and roadmap.

shouldTrigger.prompt: Evaluate our checkout flow as a whole and recommend the highest-leverage improvements.
shouldTrigger.reason: Broad feature analysis with gaps, competitor context, and roadmap.

shouldTrigger.prompt: Run /feature-audit reporting effort:extra and compare it against competitors before telling me what to build next.
shouldTrigger.reason: Explicit high-end effort decorators should still route to the broad feature audit skill.

shouldTrigger.prompt: Give me a broad audit of team management: business value, UX, technical constraints, and gaps.
shouldTrigger.reason: Broad feature analysis with gaps, competitor context, and roadmap.

shouldTrigger.prompt: What is missing in this feature overall, including competitor expectations and rollout risks?
shouldTrigger.reason: Broad feature analysis with gaps, competitor context, and roadmap.

shouldTrigger.prompt: Run a feature audit on our reporting flow and prioritize the improvement paths.
shouldTrigger.reason: Broad feature analysis with gaps, competitor context, and roadmap.

shouldNotTrigger.prompt: Be brutally honest about this startup idea, and if it survives scaffold the project plan and CLAUDE.md for me.
shouldNotTrigger.reason: Routes to /idea-audit: Project idea evaluation plus scaffolding request.

shouldNotTrigger.prompt: Review this diff for runtime bugs, security issues, and broken logic. Keep false positives low.
shouldNotTrigger.reason: Routes to /quick-review: Fast code review of a diff or PR.

shouldNotTrigger.prompt: Do a deep pre-release review of this branch with security, correctness, and architecture lenses.
shouldNotTrigger.reason: Routes to /deep-review: Heavy multi-perspective code review request.

shouldNotTrigger.prompt: Find the real bug in this flaky payment flow, prove the root cause, fix it, and add a regression test.
shouldNotTrigger.reason: Routes to /deep-fix: Root-cause-first debugging and verified fix request.

shouldNotTrigger.prompt: Generate unit tests for src/orders.js and follow the repo's Vitest style.
Analyze this branch diff and give me a deploy checklist: env vars, migrations, new workers, and breaking changes.
shouldNotTrigger.reason: Routes to /release-check: Deploy or ship-readiness checklist request.

shouldNotTrigger.prompt: Create a draft PR for this branch with a concise title, summary, and affected areas.
shouldNotTrigger.reason: Routes to /create-pr: Explicit request to open or draft a PR or MR.

shouldNotTrigger.prompt: Scout the best external skills for this repo and explain which ones we should import first.
shouldNotTrigger.reason: Routes to /skill-scout: Scout external skill catalogs for relevant imports.

shouldNotTrigger.prompt: Give me a v0.dev prompt for redesigning the analytics dashboard.
shouldNotTrigger.reason: Routes to /v0-design: Explicit request for a v0.dev design prompt.

shouldNotTrigger.prompt: Help me think through 2-3 ways to add invite approvals to our existing product and turn the winner into a design spec before we code.
shouldNotTrigger.reason: Routes to /feature-design: solution design and approach comparison for one feature before implementation.
